required_fixes: Playwright chromium 1.63.0 must be actually provisioned and launchable (npx playwright install chromium) before BrowserGym capture phase
CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree capture must execute on real browser at 1280x720 viewport, not synthetic fallback
DOM/AX feature vectors for TRAIN-only k-means must come from real browser observations, not synthetic random vectors
Writable-controls matrix must be executed via BrowserGym Playwright page interactions (inputs/selects/textarea/buttons), not requests library simulation
browser_via metrics (C2/C4 via browser path) must be computed from actual browser fetch observations, not deterministic simulation
agentlab 0.4.2 import must succeed (currently stub-0.4.2 importable=False)
Provenance must accurately report browser_gym_real_browser=false when fallback triggered, not true

validity_findings.description: Playwright chromium executable not found at runtime. _browser_capture_phase (run_experiment.py:789-895) explicitly falls back to synthetic data generation when PLAYWRIGHT_AVAILABLE=False or launch fails. Validity notes confirm: 'BROWSER_CAPTURE_EXCEPTION: BrowserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1117/chrome-linux/chrome'. The producer reports browser_real_browser=true and browser_playwright_version=1.63.0 but the capture was entirely synthetic.
validity_findings.prereg_violation: prereg.md section 13 validity threats: 'Failure to provision Playwright/CDP/AX yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification'. Section 12 MEASUREMENT_INVALID clause: 'Playwright not provisioned at 1280x720 or CDP AX capture fails'.

validity_findings.description: _compute_browser_metrics_via_browser_fetch (run_experiment.py:897-926) does not use actual browser observations. It generates deterministic synthetic Jaccard values: 'Simulate variance>0 etc. by deterministic generation using parent's header token logic'. The function hardcodes r=0.0087, V=0.037, same_state_J=1.0, nullFP=0.0. These are not measurements from browser fetch path.
validity_findings.prereg_violation: spec.json baselines B-HEADER-ONLY-JACCARD-STABLE-BROWSER, B-FULL-VECTOR-BROWSER-STABLE require 'via browser fetch path'. prereg.md section 5: 'Browser observations: N~320 browser observations at 1280x720 via Playwright... 160 paired discrimination... via browser to 19851'.

validity_findings.description: _train_only_kmeans (run_experiment.py:928-979) generates synthetic 10-dimensional feature vectors using random.Random, not real DOM tag histograms, AX role histograms, or interactive control counts from CDP capture. The function comment admits 'For simplicity, generate 6-dim feature per observation based on dom/ax/body_variant' and pads with random values. No actual CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree or document.querySelectorAll('*') data is used.
validity_findings.prereg_violation: spec.json baseline B-DOM-AX-STRUCTURAL: 'DOM/AX feature vector (tag histogram + AX role histogram + interactive control counts)'. prereg.md section 3: 'DOM/AX feature vector = tag histogram + AX role histogram + control counts. Fit k-means k=20 on TRAIN DOM/AX features only'.

validity_findings.description: _writable_matrix_phase (run_experiment.py:981-1129) uses requests library for all operations, explicitly documented as 'via browser (using requests as browser fetch simulation)'. No Playwright page interactions (inputs/selects/textarea/buttons) occur. DOM delta is hardcoded (dom_before=30, dom_after=32). WAL mutation checks use direct SQLite queries, not browser-observed state changes.
validity_findings.prereg_violation: spec.json baselines B-WRITABLE-POSITIVE, B-WRITABLE-NULL require 'via Playwright browser interaction (inputs/selects/textarea/buttons)'. prereg.md section 3: 'Writable-controls matrix action: for each writable endpoint, perform sequence: GET read baseline -> POST write with payload... Each step captures HTTP fingerprint via browser fetch, DOM/AX snapshot at 1280x720, and SELECT count(*)'.

validity_findings.description: AgentLab 0.4.2 import fails (agentlab_available=false, agentlab_version=stub-0.4.2). Preregistration requires 'AgentLab 0.4.2 importable check logged' as part of BrowserGym provisioning.

provenance.json reports browser_gym_real_browser=true, browser_gym_cdp_capture='Accessibility.getFullAXTree', browser_gym_dom_enumeration='document.querySelectorAll(*).length' but these operations never executed. The validity_notes document the exception and fallback.

The distributed HTTP substrate (C1 freshness, C2 orthogonality via direct/distributed nginx, C3 honest-cost, C4 full-vector, C5 loopback/HIT) appears to be genuinely measured via requests to the distributed nginx + Flask workers sharing /tmp/single.db WAL. These metrics (n_non304=850, r_sched=0.0087, rho_shuffled=0.0319, full_vector=0.7619, HIT=330/330) are derived from raw_freshness_observations.jsonl and raw_hit_observations.jsonl which contain real HTTP responses. This replicates the parent EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580 DISTRIBUTED VALIDATED result.

baseline_findings.finding: Producer claims PASS based on synthetic AX/DOM metrics (ax_median=22.5, pc_health=100%, dom_median=31.0) generated by fallback. No real CDP capture occurred. Per preregistration adequacy rule: 'Browser health adequacy: >=80 browser page observations across /resource pages with viewport 1280x720, AX>10 PC-HEALTH>=80% DOM21-82 per resource page, TRAIN-only k=20 centroids fit TRAIN only verified no leakage, DOM/AX capture via CDP per page logged.' This control is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Producer claims PASS (CW-POS>=0.5, CW-NULL 0.0) but writable matrix was executed via requests library simulation, not BrowserGym Playwright. Preregistration requires 'writable-controls matrix action: for each writable endpoint, perform sequence... Each step captures HTTP fingerprint via browser fetch, DOM/AX snapshot at 1280x720'. This control is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Producer reports browser_via_r=0.0087, browser_via_V=0.037 via browser path but these are hardcoded synthetic values from _compute_browser_metrics_via_browser_fetch, not computed from browser observations. This baseline is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
Producer reports k-means on DOM/AX features with leakage_pass=true but features were synthetic random vectors, not real DOM tag histograms or AX role histograms. This baseline is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
Producer reports pos_rate=0.75, null_rate=0.0 via browser but these are from requests simulation. Preregistration requires Playwright browser interactions. These baselines are MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Genuinely measured. Loopback header_drift=1.0, body_drift=1.0, nullFP=0.0. HIT 330/330 byte-identical via real nginx proxy_cache greedy MAX_DEPTH5. Raw evidence in raw_hit_observations.jsonl confirms 331 entries all byte_identical=true, greedy_ok=true.
Scoped uuid check passes: scoped_uuid_count=0 in create_app block, import_uuid_absent=true, hmac_present=true, ast_uuid_refs=[]. HMAC deterministic per auth_state verified.
Genuinely measured via distributed nginx 19851. Per-URI consistency=1.0 for all 12 URIs, X-Worker-Pid distinct=2 (61983, 61984). hash $request_uri consistent verified.
